testcase.name: Scenario: Apply a type filter to a mixed selection: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:288:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply a type filter to a mixed selection ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a recent part and a recent assembly are checked in List View ✔ And no other rows are checked and no recent-document filters are active ✔ When the user opens Filter and selects Part ✔ Then the selected part remains checked and highlighted ✔ And the assembly is not displayed ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected remain displayed ✔ When the user clears the active filter ✔ Then the part remains checked ✔ And the assembly is displayed again unchecked
